# AEONIX

> AEONIX is a free, open-source standalone subtractive synthesizer for Windows 10/11 (64-bit), built with C++20 and JUCE 8. It is designed for cinematic pads, atmospheric plucks and experimental sound design.

## Facts

- Name: AEONIX
- Version: 0.1.0
- Price: free
- License: AGPL-3.0
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit
- Format: standalone desktop application. Not a VST, VST3, AU, AAX or CLAP plugin.
- Interface languages: English and Spanish
- Controls: 64 sound-design controls on a single screen
- Synthesis: one oscillator, filter, envelopes, LFO and unison
- Effects: stereo delay and reverb
- Input: MIDI keyboards, on-screen keyboard, pitch and modulation wheels
- Extras: preset manager with search, filters, favourites and recents; four themes; three text sizes
- Install: unzip the release and run `AEONIX.exe`; the C++ runtime is linked statically
- Size: ZIP 3.5 MB, executable 8.1 MB
- Code signing: the 0.1.0 executable is not signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn once
- User data: `%APPDATA%\Aeonix` and `Documents\Aeonix\Presets`

## Links

- Website (English): https://amareca.github.io/aeonix-synth/
- Website (Spanish): https://amareca.github.io/aeonix-synth/es/

- License: https://github.com/amareca/aeonix-synth/blob/main/LICENSE
- Issues: https://github.com/amareca/aeonix-synth/issues

## What AEONIX is not

- Not a plugin yet. VST3 support is planned, not available.
- Not a sampler, a wavetable synth or a modular environment.
- Not paid software, and not a demo or a limited trial.

## Español

AEONIX es un sintetizador sustractivo standalone, gratuito y open source (AGPL-3.0) para Windows 10/11 de 64 bits. Está pensado para pads cinematográficos, plucks atmosféricos y diseño sonoro experimental. La versión 0.1.0 no es un plugin VST/VST3.

- Web en español: https://amareca.github.io/aeonix-synth/es/
- Código y descargas: https://github.com/amareca/aeonix-synth
